info.name: Orchestrator E2E Conversation Tests
info.description:
End-to-End Chat Conversation Test Matrix (7 Sets) for QA/UAT testing of the Intelligent Orchestrator.

This collection tests multi-turn conversation flows:
- Set 1: Explore > Filter > Schedule
- Set 2: Eligibility > Narrow > Change Mind
- Set 3: Review > Reschedule > Cancel
- Set 4: Filter > Drill Down > Cancel
- Set 5: Eligibility > Category > Exit Gracefully
- Set 6: Review > Reschedule with Corrections
- Set 7: Browse > Weather > Decide > Schedule
- Bug Fix Tests for v1.1.9

**IMPORTANT**: Run requests in order within each folder to maintain session context.
